description: Les bornes de recharge de à Roubaix is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Métropole Européenne de Lille . Location of charging stations for electric vehicles with the characteristics of the charging stations and their operating status. Coverage: Métropole Européenne de Lille . The portal shows the English title as "Electric vehicle charging stations in Roubaix" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Métropole Européenne de Lille . Its keywords include voiture, bornes, recharge. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
